items.title: Evaluate Vercel Flags from another project without sharing SDK keys.
items.summary: let applications evaluate flags defined in another Vercel project within the same team, without managing SDK keys.Project ConnectionsPreviously, sharing flags between projects required copying a server SDK key into an environment variable and managing it manually. Connected projects authenticate using their deployment’s identity. For local development,  retrieves your project’s OIDC token.vercel env pullManage access from the  page under your project's Flags section, or with  in the CLI. Connections grant read-only access across all environments. The consumer deployment determines the flag environment (production deployments evaluate production flags). Connectionsvercel flags connectionsIn the consumer application, create an adapter with the source project’s ID.Access can be revoked without redeploying.
